chapters.title: Still taking screenshots for every slide?
chapters.answer: Save panel F straight from the PDF, then export a slide with its page number.

chapters.title: How do I read a plot made with an unfamiliar method?
chapters.answer: Click the axis, legend and peak in 8A. Then look up PCA in the single-cell figure and ask about its caption.

chapters.title: I understand each figure. How do they fit together?
chapters.answer: Start with the paper’s question, then follow a figure on the map back to its evidence.
